summary: Backend testing of The Ultradian Network Phase 1 completed. All 16 pytest cases passed (100%). Covered: health/release-window, auth/me (401/200), logout invalidates session, application submit -> pending -> approve/decline flips user status, admin RBAC (403 for non-admin list), profile validation (exactly 3 objectives, bio<=280, unapproved=403), objectives_version bump + history, GET /api/profile/{id} 404/200, post creation with status enforcement, 500-char limit, public feed (no auth, 14-day window) and home feed (approved-only). Verified no MongoDB _id leaks across all responses.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/posts.py home_feed: comment says 'own posts first then network' but query returns network-wide ordered by created_at (no preference for self). Acceptable for Phase 1 but worth clarifying.
services/auth_helpers.py: ADMIN_EMAILS is parsed at import time. If ADMIN_EMAILS env var changes, requires backend restart (expected behavior, but worth noting).
routes/profiles.py upsert_profile: `doc.pop('_id', None)` is defensive but unnecessary because insert/update used a constructed dict without _id; harmless.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers in a future revision.

Brevo and partners-bridge external calls are best-effort but happen synchronously inside request handlers (requests.get with 15s timeout in auth /session). On provider slowness this will block the event loop; consider httpx async or background tasks.
test_credentials: No external creds used. Test users + sessions seeded directly via mongosh into test_database (users, user_sessions). Admin email peter@1691inc.com matches ADMIN_EMAILS allowlist; tokens are sent as Authorization: Bearer headers.
seed_data_creation: Each test fixture creates fresh users (approved_user, needs_app_user, admin_user) with unique user_ids/tokens and cleans up at teardown (users, user_sessions, applications, profiles, posts, objective_history).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_ultradian_backend.py as regression suite. Fixtures in conftest.py seed via mongosh against test_database (DB_NAME from backend/.env). Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_ultradian_backend.py -v. BASE_URL comes from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Backend uses Bearer token auth as alternative to HttpOnly cookie.
